rules.title: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting
rules.requirement: Bill S.2983 would prohibit algorithmic rent setting in Massachusetts. The page gives only the bill title and history, not the operative text, so definitions, prohibited conduct and penalties are not stated.
rules.status_basis: Reported favorably by the Housing Committee on 3/12/2026 and referred to Senate Ways and Means; not enacted.
